title: Dating After a Breakup
summary: A rebound is a relationship started soon after a breakup, sometimes to avoid grief. It's wise to date again when you're curious about a new person, not just escaping pain.
answer_guidance: Keep it light, practical and encouraging. Define slang plainly and give realistic tips; avoid gender stereotypes.
